t: An open-source e-paper smartwatch kit you program in Arduino.
steps: Buy the Watchy Kit from the SQFMI shop or Crowd Supply.
Assemble the board, screen, battery, case and strap with the kit guide.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the esp32 board package by Espressif in the Boards Manager.
Install the Watchy library and let it pull in its helper libraries.
Pick ESP32S3 Dev Module, 8 MB flash and the 8M with spiffs partition scheme.
Connect the watch with a USB cable. Hold Back and Up for four seconds to enter upload mode on v3 boards.
Upload a watch face example from the Watchy library as your first test.
meta: Open Board. From $59. A few stores.
